caption: The video captures a close, apparently fixed view of a textured translucent surface resembling frosted glass or a condensation-covered pane. A soft light gradient runs across the view, with a bright whitish glow on the left fading into a darker blue-gray toward the right. Seen through this surface is a blurry dark silhouette in the center-left that suggests a building rooftop with a small vertical protrusion, alongside faint circular out-of-focus shapes clustered on the right. Fine granular speckles cover the lower-central area, while the broader silhouette and gradient remain broadly stable, with no clear translation, pan, or occlusion event visible. Only subtle grain-like variation appears in the speckled texture.
relations: Fixed viewpoint keeps the blurry rooftop silhouette and soft light gradient broadly stable without translation or occlusion.
Translucent frosted surface preserves left-bright to right-dark gradient while permitting only subtle grain-like texture variation.
Lower-central speckles maintain material continuity with minor flicker, no directional drift or shape change.
